NG.name: Nigeria
notes: Spirit bottles are sold in both 70 cl and 75 cl; set the size per product.
Big beer bottles are usually 600 ml; small bottles 330-375 ml.

US.name: United States
notes: Standard pour is 1.5 US fl oz; display amounts in fl oz.
Some states restrict happy-hour discounts on alcohol; the region pack switches the feature off there.

CA.name: Canada
notes: Standard pour is 1 oz in most provinces.
Pint size varies by province and venue (16-20 oz); set your glass size.
Quebec needs WEB-SRM certified billing and French.

GB.name: United Kingdom
notes: Gin, rum, vodka and whisky must be sold in 25 ml or 35 ml measures (or multiples); choose one per venue.
Draught beer and cider are sold in 1/3, 1/2 and 2/3 pints or multiples.
A 125 ml glass of wine must be available.
Show the 14 regulated allergens on menus.
